title: Marble
description: This week's records dropped on water like Turkish marbling ink — the ground is a field of stones cut from each cover's own colour, and one whole album sits in the middle being combed into a feather. Drag back the other way and the feather un-pulls exactly, because every pixel is solved backwards through every drop and pull.
intent: One exact marbling mechanic, finished to the edge: real album covers as inks, area-preserving drops, and analytic tines you can pull and un-pull without the image ever going soft.
